parts.name: MenuDisclosure
parts.description: An inline disclosure trigger and scrollable menu panel. Escape closes the panel and restores trigger focus; item selection closes it by default.

props.name: label
props.description: Text and accessible name of the built-in disclosure trigger.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Pair with onOpenChange.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when open is omitted.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when opening or closing is requested.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the built-in trigger.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the component.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Classes on the expanded content wrapper.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: scrollContentClassName
props.description: Class for the scrollable content wrapper inside the viewport.

parts.name: MenuPopover
parts.description: A popover menu with a built-in button trigger. Item selection closes it by default; onCloseAutoFocus can preserve navigation-driven focus.

props.name: label
props.description: Text of the built-in trigger and accessible name of the popover.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Pair with onOpenChange.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when open is omitted.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when opening or closing is requested.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the built-in trigger.

props.name: triggerAppearance
props.description: Appearance of the built-in trigger button.

props.name: onCloseAutoFocus
props.description: Called before focus returns after closing; prevent default when navigation manages focus.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

parts.name: ResponsiveMenu
parts.description: One menu subtree presented inline at ≥1024px, in a Popover at 640–1023px and in a left Drawer below 640px. Crossing layouts remounts the subtree and closes open surfaces.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible surface title for the popover or drawer.

props.name: triggerLabel
props.description: Text or accessible label of the narrow-layout navigation trigger.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the drawer close action.

props.name: layout
props.description: Responsive by default: desktop inline, tablet popover, phone drawer. Explicit values force one presentation.

props.name: triggerIconOnly
props.description: Visually hide trigger text while retaining triggerLabel as its accessible name.

props.name: triggerAppearance
props.description: Appearance of the popover/drawer trigger button.

props.name: triggerSize
props.description: Size of the popover/drawer trigger button.

props.name: drawerProps
props.description: Header actions/content and body/root classes forwarded only to the drawer layout.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

parts.name: Menu
parts.description: A native nav container providing size, orientation and active-style context to menu items. Native nav attributes and ref are forwarded.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the navigation landmark.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Container/item treatment: default or subtle.

props.name: activeAppearance
props.description: Default active-item style: subtle marker, solid contrast, or emphasis with text scale and ink color.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Vertical navigation list or horizontal navigation row.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size: small, medium or large.

props.name: groupGap
props.description: Gap in pixels between groups; omitted uses the size-dependent spacing token.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM identifier for the rendered element.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.

parts.name: MenuGroup
parts.description: A labelled group of menu items. Native div attributes and ref apply to the group wrapper.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible group heading and accessible group name.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM identifier for the rendered element.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.

parts.name: MenuItem
parts.description: A native navigation link with active and disabled states. Disabled items lose href and keyboard tab access. Native anchor attributes are forwarded.

props.name: href
props.description: Navigation destination.

props.name: active
props.description: Mark the item current. Defaults aria-current to page; an explicit aria-current can select location.

props.name: activeAppearance
props.description: Override the active style inherited from Menu: subtle, solid, or emphasis.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Remove href and tab access and prevent activation.

props.name: dismissOnSelect
props.description: Close the enclosing menu on unmodified primary activation, even when onClick prevents navigation.

props.name: icon
props.description: Decorative leading icon.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Trailing content, such as a count or shortcut.

props.name: target
props.description: Browsing context for the linked destination, such as _self or _blank.

props.name: rel
props.description: Link relationship tokens. New-window links also receive noopener noreferrer.

props.name: aria-current
props.description: Current navigation position. Used only when active is true; defaults to page.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Native link activation handler; prevent default to handle navigation in the app.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM identifier for the rendered element.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.

parts.name: MenuAction
parts.description: A native button for menu actions. Prevent default in onClick to keep the enclosing menu open. Native button attributes are forwarded.

props.name: dismissOnSelect
props.description: Close the enclosing menu after activation unless onClick prevents default.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the native control.

props.name: type
props.description: Native control type.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Native activation handler.

props.name: name
props.description: Native form submission field name.

props.name: value
props.description: Current native control value. Pair with onChange for controlled input.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM identifier for the rendered element.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.
